guides.title: 源汲極接觸電阻控制：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Source-drain contact resistance control: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「電阻與比接觸電阻」建立判讀邊界。接觸電阻與比接觸電阻的單位不同。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate resistance and resistivity to define the interpretation boundary. Contact resistance and specific contact resistivity have different units. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜電阻與比接觸電阻：檢查結果是否能支持「接觸電阻與比接觸電阻的單位不同。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜TLM 長度陣列：檢查結果是否能支持「不同間距的電阻斜率與截距提供不同資訊。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜接觸改善報告：檢查結果是否能支持「方法、幾何、活化、分布及可靠度都需可追溯。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate resistance and resistivity: Check whether the evidence supports: Contact resistance and specific contact resistivity have different units. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Lay out a TLM array: Check whether the evidence supports: Resistance slope and intercept across spacings provide different information. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Report contact improvement: Check whether the evidence supports: Method, geometry, activation, distributions and reliability must be traceable. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「TLM 長度陣列」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「接觸改善報告」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Lay out a TLM array: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Report contact improvement to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「電阻與比接觸電阻」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「TLM 長度陣列」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate resistance and resistivity and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for lay out a tlm array and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

related.transfer: 源汲極磊晶與接觸孔形成共同限制有效接觸面積及界面。

related.difference: 本課驗收重點是活化、界面及比接觸電阻抽取；「矽鍺選擇性磊晶」則以選擇性磊晶、晶面、活化接觸為另一個工作包。共用原理不代表可照搬尺寸、材料或接受門檻。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes activation, interfaces and specific contact-resistivity extraction; Selective silicon-germanium epitaxy treats selective epitaxy, facets and activated contacts as a different work package. Shared principles do not justify copying dimensions, materials or acceptance limits.
